sources.entry: ReviewCerberus - 100% free, open-source AI code review tool for analyzing git branch differences with comprehensive security, performance, and quality analysis. #free

summary.one_liner: ReviewCerberus is an AI-powered code review tool that analyzes git branch differences and produces structured markdown or JSON review reports, runnable locally via Docker or as a GitHub Action.
summary.what_it_does: The tool detects the current git branch, compares it against a target branch (default main, configurable), and collects changed files, commit messages and diffs upfront. An AI agent then reviews the changes for logic, security (OWASP-style issues), performance, code quality, side effects, testing gaps and documentation, using tools to read file line ranges, search the codebase and list directories. Output is a markdown report (or JSON) with a summary, a severity-ranked issues table (critical, high, medium, low) and detailed issues with location and suggested fix. Optional experimental modes add a Chain-of-Verification pass that assigns confidence scores and an OpenGrep SAST pre-scan limited to findings new on the branch. A GitHub Action variant posts summary and inline review comments on pull requests.
use_cases: review my git branch before opening a pull request
automated AI comments on pull requests in GitHub
security and performance check of code changes
quality gate that fails CI on high-severity issues
generate a markdown review report of local changes
run code review with a self-hosted Ollama model
how_to_run: git clone the repository, then run: poetry install
Or use the GitHub Action: uses: Kirill89/reviewcerberus/action@v1 with model_provider and API key inputs in a workflow file
notable: Supports four model providers: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic API, Ollama, and Moonshot
Chain-of-Verification mode (experimental) that generates falsification questions and scores issue confidence 1-10
OpenGrep SAST pre-scan (experimental) that only reports findings introduced by the current branch and lets the AI dismiss false positives
GitHub Action that posts inline review comments, resolves old threads, and can fail builds at a chosen severity
Customizable review prompts and custom guideline files via --instructions
caveats: Verification and SAST modes are marked experimental
Requires an account and API credentials with a paid model provider (Bedrock, Anthropic, or Moonshot) or a running Ollama instance; the README does not state per-use costs
Diffs are truncated at 10k characters per file
Requires Python 3.11+ and git for local use; GitHub Action needs fetch-depth 0 checkout and write permissions on contents and pull requests
